# tspub — Full Documentation for LLMs

> The unified TypeScript package toolkit — init, build, check, publish in one tool.
> Source: https://github.com/anishgiri/tspub
> Docs: https://tspub.dev

## Installation

```bash
npm install -D tspub
```

## Commands

### tspub init [name]
Scaffold a new TypeScript package with correct package.json, tsconfig, CI workflow.

### tspub build
Build ESM + CJS + .d.ts using tsdown (Rolldown-based).
Options: --entry, --formats, --outDir, --dts, --sourcemap, --clean

### tspub check
Validate package against 60 rules across 5 categories.
Options: --fix, --fix-dry-run, --fix-type, --interactive, --unsafe, --strict, --rule, --format (text|json|table), --filter, --list-rules, --ignore-rules, --profile (strict|library|app)

### tspub publish [bump]
Pipeline: build → check → version → changelog → git tag → npm publish.
Options: --ci, --preid

### tspub doctor [--fix]
Diagnose and auto-repair TypeScript package issues.

### tspub scan <url> [--top N] [--json]
Scan GitHub repos for packaging issues.

### tspub changeset [add|version|status|snapshot]
Changeset-based version management (like @changesets/cli).

### tspub test-types [--dir directory]
Run .test-d.ts type declaration tests.

### tspub pack
Preview published files (npm pack --dry-run).

## Configuration (tspub.config.ts)

```typescript
import type { TspubConfig } from "tspub";

export default {
  build: {
    formats: ["esm", "cjs"],
    entry: "src/index.ts",
    outDir: "dist",
    dts: true,
    sourcemap: true,
    clean: true,
  },
  check: {
    severityOverrides: { "size/package-size": "warning", "metadata/engines": "off" },
    plugins: ["./my-plugin.js"],
    typeTests: { enabled: true, directory: "test-d" },
  },
  publish: {
    registry: "https://registry.npmjs.org",
    access: "public",
    provenance: true,
    branch: "main",
    changelogStyle: "conventional",
    ci: { enabled: true, skipPush: false },
  },
  changeset: {
    dependentBumping: "major",
    snapshotTag: "canary",
  },
} satisfies TspubConfig;
```

## All 60 Checker Rules

### exports (23 rules)
- exports/type-module (error, safe fix) — Check that type: "module" is set
- exports/exports-field (error, unsafe fix) — Check that exports field exists
- exports/dot-entry (error, unsafe fix) — Check that exports["."] is defined
- exports/types-order (error, safe fix) — Check types condition comes first
- exports/import-condition (error, unsafe fix) — Check for import condition
- exports/file-exists (warning) — Check exported files exist
- exports/value-invalid (error) — Check values start with ./
- exports/default-last (error, safe fix) — Check default is last condition
- exports/module-before-require (warning, safe fix) — Check module before require
- exports/imports-field (error) — Validate imports field
- exports/jsx-extensions (error) — Check JSX extensions
- exports/format-mismatch (warning) — Check ESM/CJS format consistency
- exports/module-esm-only (warning) — Check module points to ESM
- exports/fallback-array (warning) — Warn against fallback arrays
- exports/types-format (warning) — Check .d.ts/.d.cts matching
- exports/condition-types (warning) — Check conditions have types
- exports/no-deprecated-subpath (warning) — Flag trailing / in keys
- exports/imports-key-invalid (error) — Check imports keys start with #
- exports/browser-conflict (warning) — Warn on browser + exports conflict
- exports/file-not-published (error) — Check files are in files field
- exports/glob-matched-files (warning) — Validate wildcards match files
- exports/cjs-esmodule-interop (warning) — Check __esModule interop
- exports/cjs-default-export (info) — Detect CJS-only default export

### types (9 rules)
- types/tsconfig-exists (warning) — Check tsconfig.json exists
- types/declaration (info) — Check declaration enabled
- types/strict (warning) — Check strict mode
- types/module (warning) — Check module setting
- types/module-resolution (warning) — Check moduleResolution
- types/isolated-modules (info) — Check isolatedModules
- types/declaration-completeness (warning) — Check all exports have .d.ts
- types/no-any-export (warning) — Flag excessive any
- types/resolution (error) — Verify types resolve in node10/node16/bundler

### files (7 rules)
- files/files-field (warning, safe fix) — Check files field exists
- files/sensitive (error) — Check for .env, credentials
- files/bin-shebang (warning) — Check bin shebang
- files/all-files-format (warning) — Check format consistency
- files/prepublish (warning, safe fix) — Check prepublishOnly script
- files/duplicate-dep (error) — Check duplicate deps
- files/local-dependency (error) — Check file: protocol deps

### metadata (8 rules)
- metadata/license (warning, unsafe fix) — Check license field
- metadata/license-file (warning) — Check LICENSE file
- metadata/repository (info) — Check repository field
- metadata/engines (warning, unsafe fix) — Check engines.node
- metadata/side-effects (warning) — Check sideEffects
- metadata/deprecated-fields (warning) — Flag deprecated fields
- metadata/peer-dep-conflict (warning) — Check peer dep conflicts
- metadata/use-exports-browser (info) — Prefer exports browser

### size (1 rule)
- size/package-size (warning) — Check dist size

## Programmatic API

```typescript
// Core
import { build, check, scan, doctor, scaffold } from "tspub";
import type { CheckResult, CheckSeverity, BuildOptions, ScaffoldOptions } from "tspub";
import type { ScanOptions, ScanResult, PackageScanResult, FixChange } from "tspub";
import type { DoctorResult } from "tspub";
import type { LogLevel } from "tspub";

// Config
import { loadConfig, loadConfigWithInheritance } from "tspub";
import type { TspubConfig, TspubBuildConfig, TspubPublishConfig, TspubCheckConfig } from "tspub";

// Workspace
import { discoverWorkspaces, topoSort, isMonorepoRoot, filterPackages } from "tspub";
import type { WorkspacePackage } from "tspub";

// Versioning
import { resolveVersionBump } from "tspub";
import type { VersionBump } from "tspub";

// Plugins
import { loadPlugins } from "tspub";
import type { TspubPlugin, Rule, RuleMeta, CheckContext, Severity } from "tspub";

// Type testing
import { runTypeTests } from "tspub";
import type { TypeTestResult, TypeTestError, TypeTestOptions } from "tspub";

// Type test assertions (runtime no-ops)
import { expectType, expectNotType, expectAssignable, expectNever, expectAny } from "tspub/test-d";
```

## Plugin API

```typescript
import type { Rule, RawDiagnostic } from "tspub";

const myRule: Rule = {
  meta: {
    id: "custom/my-rule",
    description: "My custom rule",
    defaultSeverity: "warning",
    fixable: false,
    category: "custom",
  },
  check(ctx) {
    const results: RawDiagnostic[] = [];
    // ctx.pkg, ctx.dir, ctx.compilerOptions, ctx.hasBuildOutput, ctx.distFiles, ctx.allJsFiles
    return results;
  },
  fix(ctx) {
    // Optional: modify ctx.pkg in place
    return { message: "what was fixed", pkgModified: true };
  },
};

export const rules = [myRule];
// Register in tspub.config.ts: check.plugins: ["./my-plugin.js"]
```
